prompt: Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle's wide-angle pillar-mounted camera driving through a suburban intersection at midday. A single pedestrian in a yellow raincoat steps off the curb into the crosswalk directly ahead, mid-stride, one foot on the asphalt. The camera's wide-angle lens stretches the lane markings and the traffic-light poles outward at the frame edges, and the pedestrian is sharp at the centre against the faded white crosswalk paint. The image has the flat, slightly desaturated look of an automotive-grade CMOS sensor with a fixed wide-aperture lens—deep depth of field, no bokeh, even the distant strip-mall signage is readable. A raindrop streak cuts diagonally across the upper-left from the windshield, and the hood's edge and a wiper blade rest are faintly visible at the frame's bottom. The sky is overcast and featureless white, blowing out the traffic light's red signal into a soft glow.

Egocentric forward-facing narrow-FOV camera capture from an autonomous vehicle's sensor stack on a three-lane highway at 70 mph. A single brake-lit semi-truck occupies the centre lane 200 feet ahead, its rear doors and DOT reflective tape in sharp focus against the grey asphalt. The narrow telephoto lens compresses the highway perspective, stacking the truck, the lane dividers, and the concrete median barrier into flattened layers. Heat shimmer from the asphalt distorts the truck's lower edge, and road grime on the camera's exterior glass creates a faint haze across the lower third. The sky is clear blue with a hard sun creating a bright patch of glare on the truck's aluminium doors. The image timestamp reads 2024-08-22 14:11:03 in small white text at the bottom, and the dashboard's matte black surface intrudes as a dark band at the frame's very bottom edge.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle driving through a downtown corridor at night. A single cyclist with a flashing rear LED light crosses from the right lane into the vehicle's path, the red blink frozen as a streaked starburst by the camera's rolling shutter. The street is wet from recent rain, and the lane markings, traffic signals, and storefront neon signs reflect in long smeared streaks on the asphalt. The camera's auto-exposure balances for the dark road, pushing the streetlights and the cyclist's reflective vest into hard overexposure. Headlight glare from an oncoming vehicle bleeds across the left side of the frame, and the image has elevated ISO noise grain in the shadow areas—the parked cars and building facades are murky with chroma noise. The windshield's lower edge and a defroster vent are faintly visible at the bottom.

Egocentric side-repeater camera capture from a Tesla-style B-pillar camera, looking perpendicular to the vehicle's direction at a T-intersection. A single delivery van with its sliding door open is double-parked at the curb, a hand truck leaning against its bumper. The camera's fisheye-esque wide angle warps the parked cars and the row of brownstones behind the van into a gentle curve, and the van's white body and the orange parking cone beside it are the sharpest objects. The image is slightly underexposed on the shadowed building facades, with noise visible in the brickwork. The vehicle's own side mirror housing intrudes as a dark shape at the frame's left edge, and the B-pillar's black plastic trim is a vertical band at the far left. The pavement is cracked and patched, and a faded fire-hydrant zone marking is visible in yellow paint at the curb.

Egocentric rear-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle's trunk-mounted wide-angle camera on a highway on-ramp. A single motorcycle merges aggressively from the acceleration lane, leaning into the lane change, rider in a black helmet and hi-vis vest. The motorcycle is slightly motion-blurred from the closing speed, and the rear camera's wide FOV stretches the highway guardrails and the exit signage into curved distortions at the edges. The vehicle's own rear bumper and licence plate frame are in the frame's lower third, slightly out of focus, and the trunk lid's metallic paint catches a broad reflection of the overcast sky. The asphalt texture is coarse and detailed at the centre but smears at the warped periphery. Road spray from the vehicle's own tyres creates a fine mist in the lower corners.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle approaching a single-lane construction zone on a suburban road. A construction worker in an orange vest and hard hat holds a SLOW sign on a pole, standing in the centre of the lane directly ahead. The sign's octagonal shape and white text are in sharp focus, and the worker's face is partially shadowed by the hard hat brim. Orange traffic cones and concrete jersey barriers narrow the lane from both sides, and a backhoe sits idle on the dirt shoulder to the right. The image has the contrasty, slightly warm look of a sun-facing capture with the sun low behind scattered clouds—the sky graduates from pale yellow near the horizon to blue above. The vehicle's hood reflects the construction cones as orange blobs, and a bug splatter on the windshield creates a small out-of-focus smear at the upper-right.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle creeping through a school zone at 15 mph. A single child in a red backpack runs between two parked SUVs into the road ahead, captured mid-stride, one foot in the air. The camera's wide angle shows the school's chain-link fence and crossing-guard station to the left, and a row of idling parent-pickup vehicles to the right. The child is small in the frame but sharply resolved against the dark gap between the parked vehicles. A fluorescent yellow school-zone speed sign is at the right edge, warped slightly by the lens. The image is bright and evenly lit by midday overcast, and the crosswalk paint is worn to near-invisible ghost stripes. The dashboard's black edge and the rearview mirror's housing are faintly visible at the bottom and top of the frame respectively.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle navigating a grocery-store parking lot at walking speed. A single shopping cart sits abandoned in an empty parking space directly in the vehicle's path, its metal frame and plastic child seat catching the flat grey light of a cloudy afternoon. The parking lot's faded white lines and handicap symbols stretch outward in the wide-angle perspective, and the store's facade and cart-return corral are visible at the background edges. The image is unremarkable and dull—flat lighting, muted colours, the mundane texture of stained asphalt and oil spots. The vehicle's hood is visible at the bottom, showing a film of dust and a single bird dropping near the centre. The cart's chrome mesh and wobbly front wheel are the sharpest details in an otherwise low-contrast scene.

Egocentric side-facing fender camera capture from a Waymo-style vehicle driving past a bus stop on a city street. A single elderly woman sits on the bus-stop bench, a folded umbrella across her lap, visible through the gap between two parked cars. The camera's wide angle compresses her into a small but sharp figure against the bus shelter's advertisement panel. The parked cars' rooflines and the sidewalk trees warp outward at the frame edges, and the vehicle's own front fender and wheel-arch trim intrude at the bottom-left. The image has the cool blue-grey tone of an overcast urban afternoon, and the bus shelter's backlit ad panel is the brightest element, slightly blooming at its edges. A taxi in the adjacent lane is motion-blurred in the mid-ground.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle on a two-lane rural highway at dusk. A single white-tailed deer stands frozen in the right lane ahead, body broadside, head turned toward the approaching vehicle, eyes reflecting the headlights as two bright green discs. The road is unlit, and the headlamp beams create a hard cone of illumination on the deer and the asphalt, while the surrounding fields and treeline are near-black with heavy noise. The lane's centre-line dashes and the gravel shoulder are visible in the beam, and the deer's brown coat and the white underside of its raised tail are the only colour in the frame. The windshield has a faint internal reflection of the dashboard's instrument cluster ghosted in the upper portion, and a single moth is a bright blur streaking through the headlight beam.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle stopped at a red light on a four-lane urban road. A single fire engine with full lights approaches head-on in the oncoming lanes, its red-and-white LED light bar creating harsh flare streaks and lens artefacts across the upper half of the frame. The fire engine's chrome grille and the large unit number painted on the bumper are visible through the glare. The traffic light's red signal is a soft glow at the top of the frame, and the intersection's crosswalk and stop line are in the foreground. Other vehicles at the intersection are pulling to the right, their brake lights adding red smears to the wet pavement. The camera's auto-exposure struggles with the emergency lights, darkening the entire scene to compensate, pushing buildings and sky into murky underexposure.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle entering a highway tunnel, the transition from bright daylight to artificial orange sodium lighting creating extreme exposure contrast. A single overhead lane-control sign showing a green arrow is at the centre of the tunnel's mouth, and the tunnel's tiled walls and curved ceiling compress inward. The exterior daylight behind is blown out to solid white at the frame edges, while the tunnel interior is dark with the sodium lamps just beginning to register as orange smears on the tile. The vehicle ahead—a white SUV—is a silhouette transitioning from overexposed to underexposed in the same frame. The camera's ISP is mid-transition, creating a visible band of correct exposure across the middle third while top and bottom are clipped. Road grime on the windshield becomes visible as a scattering haze in the high-contrast transition zone.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle yielding at a single-lane roundabout in a European town. A single blue city bus occupies the roundabout's curved lane directly ahead, its route number and destination displayed on the electronic header board. The roundabout's central island with a manicured hedge and a small fountain warps to the left in the wide-angle perspective, and the yield sign and painted shark-teeth markings are in the foreground. The bus's articulated section and the advertisement wrap on its side are in detail, and a cyclist follows close behind the bus in the same lane. The image has the clean, grey-daylight quality of a northern European afternoon, and the cobblestone-edged roundabout and the stone-fronted buildings behind it are sharp edge to edge. The vehicle's wiper-spray nozzle is visible as a small bump on the hood's trailing edge.

Egocentric rear-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle on a two-lane country road, a single lifted pickup truck tailgating aggressively, its chrome grille and bull bar filling the centre of the frame at dangerously close range. The truck's headlights are on despite daylight, creating two bright discs that flare into the camera, and the driver's silhouette is barely visible behind the tinted windshield. The rear camera's wide angle stretches the road's grassy shoulders and the fence posts into curving lines, and the vehicle's own rear bumper and tail-light housings frame the bottom of the image. The asphalt between the two vehicles is minimal—perhaps fifteen feet—and the centre-line dashes are compressed by the perspective. A bumper sticker on the truck is partially readable. Dust kicked up from the road's shoulder drifts across the lower frame.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle driving through heavy rain on a six-lane interstate. A single tractor-trailer in the adjacent lane throws a massive wall of spray from its eighteen wheels, the rooster tail filling the right third of the frame in a grey-white curtain. The camera's view through the spray is nearly opaque, reducing the truck's body to a dark smudge with faint red tail lights. The vehicle's own lane is visible ahead through sheets of rain hitting the windshield between wiper sweeps—the wipers are mid-arc, one blade creating a clear wedge of sharper road view at the bottom-left. The lane markings are submerged under standing water, and the road surface is a mirror reflecting the grey sky. The camera's auto-exposure is bright to compensate for the low-light storm conditions, and the noise level is elevated throughout. Water beads on the camera's exterior glass create dozens of small out-of-focus circles in the upper portion.

Egocentric side-repeater camera capture from an autonomous vehicle's fender camera as it passes a single cyclist in a protected bike lane on an urban boulevard. The cyclist is in sharp focus at the frame's centre, wearing a messenger bag slung across the back and pedalling with one hand on the bars, the other signalling a left turn. The bike lane's green paint and the plastic bollard separators warp outward in the wide-angle lens, and the parked cars beyond the bike lane are slightly motion-blurred from the vehicle's own movement. The vehicle's front wheel arch and the side mirror's underside are dark shapes at the frame's edge. The image is contrasty from direct sun, with the cyclist casting a hard shadow on the green paint, and the building facades behind are a mixture of sharp brick and blown-out glass reflections.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle driving through dense fog on a narrow rural road at dawn. A single tractor with a rear-mounted brush cutter occupies the road ahead, moving slowly, its amber rotating beacon barely visible as a diffuse orange glow in the fog. The tractor's muddy tyres and the three-point hitch are the sharpest elements, and the rest of the machine dissolves into the white-grey wall of fog. The road's hedgerows are ghostly dark shapes on either side, and the centre line is intermittent and faded. The camera's sensor struggles with the uniform low-contrast scene—the histogram is bunched in the mid-tones, and the image has a milky, flat quality with no true blacks or whites. The vehicle's headlights illuminate the fog particles in two soft forward cones, and moisture on the windshield creates a diffuse halo around the tractor's beacon.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle stopped at a marked crosswalk in a residential neighbourhood. A single woman pushes a stroller across the crosswalk from left to right, her body and the stroller in mid-crossing, two thirds of the way across. The stroller's canopy and wheels and the woman's sneakers are in sharp detail against the white crosswalk stripes. A stop sign and a residential mailbox are at the right edge, and a parked minivan is behind the pedestrian on the far side. The image is bright suburban daylight, slightly overexposed on the concrete sidewalk, with the shadows under the parked cars showing mild noise. The camera's lens has a faint radial colour shift—magenta fringing on the stop sign's edge and cyan on the mailbox—and the vehicle's hood with a thin layer of pollen dust is at the bottom of the frame.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle mid-lane-change on a highway, a single white sedan occupying the target lane at a distance of roughly 100 feet. The sedan's rear is centred in the frame, its model badge and exhaust tips visible, and the lane-divider dashes below are angled as the vehicle crosses them. The camera captures the transition moment—the dashed line is directly under the vehicle's centreline, and the new lane opens ahead. The highway's concrete barriers and sound walls stretch symmetrically at the edges, and the road surface shows tyre-rubber deposits and tar-patch repairs in high resolution. An overhead electronic sign displays a speed advisory, slightly overexposed. The image is clinical and undramatic—dry pavement, clear sky, midday flat lighting—the quality of routine sensor data captured at 30 frames per second with no artistic intent.

Egocentric front-camera capture from an autonomous vehicle in bumper-to-bumper traffic on a multi-lane urban expressway. A single black SUV directly ahead fills the centre of the frame at a distance of roughly eight feet, its rear wiper, brake lights, and licence plate in sharp macro-like detail from the close range. The SUV's rear window shows the ghostly reflection of the ego vehicle's own windshield and roofline. Adjacent lanes are packed with vehicles of various colours visible in the peripheral wide-angle view, all stationary, brake lights creating a field of red points. The overhead highway signs and a pedestrian overpass bridge are in the background, and the asphalt between the two vehicles shows oil-rainbow iridescence in a puddle. The image has the bored, unremarkable quality of a traffic-jam dashcam frame—nothing dramatic, just the mundane texture of gridlock, exhaust haze, and brake dust on every surface.
